title: The Night the Trains Stopped
subtitle: Buckinghamshire, 1963
note: İkinci konu — hattın konudan bağımsız çalıştığını göstermek için duruyor. Kendi konunu eklemek için bu dosyayı kopyala, narration'ı değiştir ve `npm run beats -- content/story-<ad>.json` çalıştır.
narration: In 1963, fifteen men in army uniforms waited beside a railway bridge in Buckinghamshire. They had rewired the signal lamp with a glove and a battery. The mail train slowed, then stopped in the dark. The robbers took one hundred and twenty sacks of banknotes. Two and a half million pounds left the platform in a lorry. The farmhouse where they hid was twenty-seven miles away. They played Monopoly with the real money while they waited. A fingerprint on the board sent most of them to prison. One man escaped to Brazil and stayed for thirteen years. The driver of the train never worked again. Nobody has ever found the last of the money.
